title: refactor(Development/AbelianVarietyTheory): remove duplicate BaseChangeHomTopBijective and reuse PlaceInt.exists_isExt_and_trans
body:
`BaseChangeHomTopBijective.lean` proved `GlobalTheory.ThetaBound.exists_isExt_and_trans` and its seven helper lemmas with the exact same statements as `GlobalTheory.PlaceInt.exists_isExt_and_trans` and its helpers in `ExistsIntegralFramedPointBaseChangeCdvrTransitiv.lean`. This PR deletes the duplicate module and updates its only two callers (`ExistsExtAllModelsUniformised.lean` and `BddAllOfThetaSumOnCover.lean`) to use `GlobalTheory.PlaceInt.exists_isExt_and_trans`.

- Removed module: `Development.AbelianVarietyTheory.Proofs.RingsOfIntegers.BaseChangeHomTopBijective`.
- Removed declarations: `GlobalTheory.ThetaBound.Ext.baseChangeHom_top_bijective`, `GlobalTheory.ThetaBound.Ext.eq_smul_iff`, `GlobalTheory.ThetaBound.Ext.existsUnique_mul_pull`, `GlobalTheory.ThetaBound.Ext.existsUnique_mul_of_isoMaps`, `GlobalTheory.ThetaBound.Ext.exists_eigenbasis_pullback`, `GlobalTheory.ThetaBound.Ext.exists_restrict`, `GlobalTheory.ThetaBound.Ext.integral_of_frMap`, `GlobalTheory.ThetaBound.exists_isExt_and_trans`.
